description: A face that rides up and down the panel with the voltage put into it, and nothing else

inputs.text: The voltage the face rides on, 0V at the bottom and 10V at the top; a polyphonic cable draws a face per channel

menu: Invert — ticked, the face rises as the voltage rises; unticked, it falls
-5 to +5 — reads the input as -5V to +5V instead of 0V to 10V
Snow Mode — draws a snowflake in place of the face
